# TechVantix

> TechVantix (techvantix.com) is a digital marketing and technology agency
> specialising in SEO, GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), AEO (Answer Engine
> Optimization), website design & development, AI chatbot & marketing
> automation, Meta & Google Ads management, social media marketing and lead
> generation campaigns.

TechVantix combines marketing strategy with engineering: campaigns backed by
clean conversion tracking, fast SEO-ready websites, and AI automation that
responds to every lead instantly, 24/7. Contact: info@techvantix.com

## Services

- [SEO, GEO & AEO](https://techvantix.com/services/seo-geo-aeo/): Technical
  SEO, content strategy, Generative Engine Optimization and Answer Engine
  Optimization — visibility on Google, ChatGPT, Gemini and AI Overviews.
- [Website Design & Development](https://techvantix.com/services/web-development/):
  Fast, mobile-first, conversion-focused websites, landing pages and
  e-commerce stores with SEO-ready foundations.
- [AI Chatbots & Automation](https://techvantix.com/services/ai-chatbot-automation/):
  Custom AI assistants for websites, WhatsApp and social channels that answer
  customers, qualify leads and book appointments 24/7, plus workflow automation.
- [Meta & Google Ads](https://techvantix.com/services/paid-advertising/):
  Performance campaigns on Google Search, YouTube, Facebook and Instagram with
  full conversion tracking and creative testing.
- [Social Media Marketing](https://techvantix.com/services/social-media-marketing/):
  Content strategy, short-form video, community management and growth campaigns.
- [Lead Generation](https://techvantix.com/services/lead-generation/):
  Full-funnel lead systems — targeted campaigns, landing pages, lead magnets,
  CRM integration and instant AI follow-up.
